title: ARCH↔ALL-ADR-001: Architecture Decision Record Submission + Approval
description: Any role submits an ADR; STRATEGIC ADRs require Architect approval (ARB ratification). JSON Schema translation of the authoritative ADR_SCHEMA (v1.0.0); validation rules V-ADR-01..12 apply. The ADR process is the binding mechanism for any contract/budget/security-baseline/OTA change (Never-Silently-Deviate).

role.description: Obsidian wikilink to initiator role SKILL file.

approvers.description: ≥ 1 entry with approved = true required for status = DECIDED (V-ADR-07).

options_considered.description: At least 2 options (V-ADR-05); each ≥ 1 pro and ≥ 1 con (V-ADR-06).

contract_id.description: Must resolve against the contract registry (V-ADR-09 ref / V-CR cross-check).

business_impact_assessment.description: Populated by Business Consultant; required for cost-material ADRs (V-ADR-12).

x-macp.tier_rationale: STRATEGIC ADRs touch platform/protocol/security-baseline/OTA — permanent HITL gate; ARB ratification and Architect approval required. TACTICAL/LOCAL ADRs may resolve at lower tiers but the schema gate is uniform.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (on any Never-Silently-Deviate condition); SLA per decision tier (Tier-1 4 business hours)
confirm_conditions: id matches ^ADR-\d{4}$; status, decision_class, tier are valid enums
options_considered has ≥ 2 entries, each with ≥ 1 pro and ≥ 1 con
status = DECIDED implies date_decided non-null and ≥ 1 approver approved = true
decision_class = STRATEGIC implies an Architect approver is present (V-ADR-09)
affected_contracts IDs resolve in the registry
reject_conditions: fewer than 2 options or an option missing pros/cons
STRATEGIC ADR DECIDED without Architect approval
cost-material decision missing a BIA recommendation (V-ADR-12)
BIA recommendation = REJECT on a STRATEGIC ADR marked DECIDED without ARB override
counter_conditions: decision_class asserted LOCAL but affected_contracts cross ≥ 2 roles — request reclassification upward
an affected interface contract change lacks a paired CCR + version bump — request the CCR first
